 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **"Spectecular"** is spelled incorrectly in the given context. It should be "Spectacular", which means something strikingly impressive or dramatic. (शानदार)

 
 
• **Example: **The fireworks display was absolutely spectacular.
 
 
 
• **"Spectecular"** should be spelled as "Spectacular", which means an event or performance that is visually impressive. (शानदार)
 
 
• **Example: **The spectacular sunset left everyone in awe.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enthusiastic **(उत्साही): Showing intense and eager enjoyment or interest.

 
 
• **Example:** She is very enthusiastic about her new job.
 
 
 
• **Gracious **(कृपालु): Courteous, kind, and pleasant.
 
 
• **Example: **The hostess was gracious and welcoming to all her guests.
 
 
 
• **Reliable** (विश्वसनीय): Consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a reliable employee who always meets his deadlines.
